newsitem.title: PERU: Peru 42-day CDs draw 15.76 pct avg rate at sale.
newsitem.headline: Peru 42-day CDs draw 15.76 pct avg rate at sale.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru said on Tuesday it accepted bids for 42-day Certificates of Deposit (CDs) worth 10.9 million soles at an effective average annual rate of 15.76 percent during a bank auction.
The CDs have a December 11 starting date.
The accepted bids also had a minimum rate of 15.00 percent and a maximum rate of 16.15 percent, the bank said.
At the last CD auction November 28, 28-day CDs drew an average rate of 15.74 percent.
At Tuesday's auction, the bank said it received bids on the CDs totalling 38.4 million soles.
The bank had offered 30 million soles worth of CDs.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
